name: AI Usage Monitor Widget
subtitle: Plan limits and token totals
platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
promotionalText: See how much of your AI plan is left, when your limits reset, and how many tokens you used. Put it all on your Mac desktop with two widgets.
description:
See how much of your AI plan is left before you start the next task. AI Usage puts two widgets on your Mac desktop: one for remaining plan limits and one for the work you’ve done.

Plan limits
See remaining percentages and reset times when your tool reports them. Sign in with OpenAI or use recent Codex session readings for ChatGPT limits. For Claude, connect Claude Desktop to see its last saved percentages and when they were recorded. Claude Code users can also connect an interactive terminal session. For Google, connect the signed-in Antigravity desktop app on this Mac to see the quota it reports for its model groups.

Usage totals
Choose your Claude Code, Codex or Google Antigravity history folder to count recorded requests and tokens for today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days. Estimated API value shows what recorded usage would cost at published API rates. Your provider determines your actual bill.

Start on this Mac
The setup guide lets you choose the tools you use. Connect just one to get started, or try the widgets with sample data before connecting an account. Reading local history and connecting plan limits are separate choices. Your widgets work without a dashboard or another computer.

AI Usage is an independent app.

reviewNotes: Open AI Usage. On a clean Mac the guide opens to Choose tools. Select Preview with sample data to review without any accounts or history, then Control-click the desktop, select Edit Widgets and search for AI Usage. Both widgets label sample readings. To try local setup, choose Set up this Mac in Settings. Choose tools, then connect any combination of history and quota. Connect history uses macOS’s read-only folder picker. For Claude Desktop quota, choose Connect Claude Desktop and approve the preselected Claude folder. Only its plan usage history file is opened. The widget shows when Claude last saved its percentages and leaves out reset times the file does not supply. Open Claude usage shows the provider’s Usage page; old or missing readings may also be entered manually. The separate Claude Code terminal option applies only to an interactive CLI session. ChatGPT offers sign-in. Connect Google quota reads percentages and reset times from the installed, signed-in Antigravity desktop app. macOS asks for its daemon folder once when history permission is unavailable. No separate dashboard or Terminal command is required. Privacy policy opens an offline copy in setup and Settings. Returning users manage connections in Settings. Advanced retains Demo and the optional user-provided dashboard.
